clips.title: The story
paras: Innkeeper Norman tends the hearth at the primary tavern in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity. A quiet, diligent Forsaken, he offers travelers of the Horde respite, hearthstone bindings, and food suited to the varied tastes of both the living and the dead.

Located in the bustling Trade Quarter beneath the ruined Capital City of Lordaeron, Innkeeper Norman provides lodging for emissaries, mercenaries, and adventurers passing through the Forsaken stronghold. Despite the damp chill and alchemical stenches of the Undercity, Norman's tavern remains a bustling hub for travelers looking to anchor their hearthstones, share news from across Azeroth, or prepare for expeditions into the Plaguelands.

While Norman typically keeps to his duties selling provisions and managing rooms, the seasonal arrival of Hallow's End reveals a more peculiar side. During the holiday, Norman participates in the seasonal revelry, demanding peculiar displays—such as clucking like a chicken—from adventurous patrons eager to earn holiday treats like Undercity mints.
